title: Surly Bikes Recalls Bicycle Racks Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The recalled front bicycle rack can loosen and contact the front wheel, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 5,139.

title: Trek Recalls Super Commuter+ Electric Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front fender bolt can unthread causing the wheel to detach from the bicycle, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 2,840.

title: WilliamsRDM Recalls Cooktop Fire Suppressors Due to Risk of Failure to Activate and Suppress Fires
summary: The StoveTop FireStop (STFS) Rangehood and Microhood Automatic Cooktop Fire Suppressors can fail to activate the sealed openings that allow the suppressant powder to feed out of the canister and suppress the fire. Units: Aboult 9,300 pairs.

title: DaVinci Recalls Bassinets Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bassinet's support legs can break, posing a fall hazard to babies. Units: About 3,000 (In addition, about 290 in Canada).

title: Bosch Thermotechnology Recalls Buderus Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: The siphon can become blocked, leading to a delayed ignition that can damage the boiler's exhaust system, creating a carbon monoxide hazard. Units: About 170.

title: Hallmark Recalls Candles Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: When the candle is lit, the glass jar can break, posing fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 4,500.

title: BCI Burke Recalls Merge Playground Climbers Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: A welded rung opening on the sides of the climber poses an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 440.

title: BMC Recalls Bicycles and Framesets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The fork steerer tube on the bicycles and framesets can crack or break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 840 (In addition, 94 were sold in Canada).

title: Toysmith Recalls Light-Up Magic Wands Due to Choking and Ingestion Hazards
summary: The battery cover can detach and expose the button-cell batteries, posing choking and ingestion hazards to young children. Units: About 58,000 (in addition 204 units were sold in Canada).

title: Hillsdale Furniture Recalls Five-Drawer Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The chests are unstable and can tip over if not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. The chests do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM F2057-17). Units: About 31,0

title: J. Crew Recalls Boys' Denim Pants Due to Aspiration and Choking Hazards
summary: Small stones can be present in the pockets or waistband of the pants from the stone washing manufacturing process, posing aspiration or choking hazards to young children. Units: About 900.

title: Profile Design Recalls Bicycle Carbon Aerobars Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The bicycle aerobars can crack and break, causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 260.

title: Bass Pro Recalls MR. STEAK™ Gas Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gas regulator hose with attached fuel gauge can melt if it comes in contact with the bottom of the grill's firebox, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,300 (in addition, about 400 were sold in Canada).
